promote_jobdef_note: SELF-PROMOTION, identical reasoning to the Databento chain (see futures_eod_databento.json) because it is the SAME shared silver jobdef: leviathan-dev-futures-eod-silver is DIGEST-PINNED in terraform (modules/batch/main.tf, var.futures_eod_image_digest) while the default promote runner leviathan-dev-silver-publisher-runner tracks the worker repo's floating :latest, so the shared-runner promote re-derives silver with a different build than the shadow it promotes. THE EXPOSURE IS LARGER HERE, not smaller: this chain promotes FOUR tasks and the free venues are exactly the legs whose dependency (xlrd, for JSE and the CEPEA archive) fails silently. The 2026-08-01 databento promote is the demonstrated failure (13/15 certified, then exit 1 on ZR/OJ under an older image's mode-blind row floor); this chain simply had not fired against a drifted runner yet. SAFE BY THE SAME PROOF EVERY FIRE: jobRoleArn=silver-publisher (glue:CreatePartition + kms:Sign) and all four --source producers run on this jobdef in the silver phase minutes earlier. ARMING: the rendered promote jobdef reaches the scheduler only through infra/terraform/envs/dev/dag_schedules.auto.tfvars.json (hand-authored, co-tenant discipline) -- regenerating _rendered/ does NOT re-arm the fire.
gate_baseline_uri_note: PER-SCHEDULE BY DECISION, and this SUPERSEDES the W1.0 seed. The rolling-census machinery is per-SCHEDULE (advance_rolling_census advances one baseline per fire, and a shared baseline would make each schedule's --diff read the other schedule's rows as unexplained drift), so silver_futures_eod carries one baseline per schedule: futures_eod_free (this one, four free venues) and futures_eod_databento. The family-level seed named in plan D6 and in jobs/audit/advance_rolling_census.py -- s3://leviathan-dev-shahem-001/cascade_census/rolling/futures_eod/census.json -- is SUPERSEDED and MUST NOT be consulted, minted or advanced; a diff against it would compare this schedule's rows to the union of both. futures_eod_gate.py gate 8 emits one silver_rebuild_gate command per schedule against its own baseline, deliberately.
chain_shape: fetch(czce|jse|cepea|miax incremental)->silver(one --source pass each, registered per leviathan_slug/trade_year)
notes: ONE DESCRIPTOR, FOUR FREE VENUES, ONE CRON AT THE LATEST OF THEM. The plan (W1a D4) allowed either one descriptor per timezone or one at the latest publication time; this is the latter, and the reason is operational rather than aesthetic: the four legs share one table, one contract, one partition scheme and one gate, so four schedules would mean four censuses diffing against each other's rows as unexplained drift (the family-vs-schedule baseline question). CRON 22:30 UTC MON-FRI covers every venue's SAME-DAY publication: CZCE post-15:00 CST = 07:00 UTC, JSE post-close SAST = ~15:00 UTC, MIAX settlement ~14:35 CT = ~19:35 UTC, CEPEA ~18:00 BRT = ~21:00 UTC. 22:30 sits after the last of them with 90 minutes of margin, and deliberately NOT at 23:00, which is the yfinance futures_prices chain's slot. MON-FRI because no venue in this set holds a weekend session; a Monday session is published in the Monday fire, unlike the Databento chain's TUE-SAT next-morning pattern (that chain waits for FINAL settlements published the following day; these four publish their own final numbers same-day). WAVE 3 + retrofit_landed: a NEW class-A registered-partition chain, not part of the frozen wave-2 CLASS-B retrofit set. FAMILY is futures_eod, never futures -- dag_catalog maps silver_futures_eod to its own family and the silver_futures prefix would swallow the live yfinance table. Incremental windows are --lookback-days rather than a templated date because the scheduler substitutes only <aws.scheduler.*> context attributes. FOUR SEPARATE SILVER TASKS, one per --source, rather than one task with four sources: each stages its own (leviathan_slug, trade_year) partitions, so one venue's bad day fails one task instead of blocking the other three, and the manifests carry per-source job labels (futures_eod_czce / _jse / _cepea / _miax). JSE's fetch takes no --lookback-days ON PURPOSE: the portal object is overwritten daily and has no history, so its own --mode backfill raises NotImplementedError per plan gate 8, and a missed fire is permanently lost data -- this is the leg whose cadence discipline matters most. CEPEA's fetch takes no window either: the widget serves the last value only. PROMOTE_MODE IS stop_and_notify, NOT autonomous, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE. Nothing has been published canonically on this table yet, the row floors are PROVISIONAL until probe P10 recalibrates them against the CZCE ~2,600-day backfill (--row-floor report is what P10 uses), and the MIAX floor rests on a single observation. stop_and_notify renders promote.tasks EMPTY, so the machine publishes SHADOW only and a human promotes. SEQUENCING, and this is the trap: leviathan.silver.freshness computes lag from the newest CANONICAL-prefix object mtime and a shadow publish deliberately never resets that clock, so flipping this chain to autonomous must happen BEFORE the futures_eod family's freshness alarm is applied -- otherwise the alarm (treat_missing_data=breaching) pages the shared topic daily. BEFORE ARMING: (a) mint the gate_baseline_uri census (it does not exist yet), (b) register leviathan-dev-futures-eod-free-fetch in terraform (leviathan-dev-futures-eod-silver is shared with the Databento chain), (c) confirm the worker image carries xlrd -- JSE and the CEPEA archive both need it and the task preflights it per source; note xlrd>=2.0 is a CORE pyproject dependency rather than a [batch] extra, so unlike the Databento chain's databento pin NO rebuild is owed for it, (d) add the dag_schedules.auto.tfvars.json entry, which is what actually arms the fire. NO SECRETS: every one of these four venues is an unauthenticated public GET, so these jobdefs need no secrets/valueFrom block at all. ARMED 2026-07-29 (user-approved, explicit): promote_mode flipped stop_and_notify -> autonomous. The preconditions the stop_and_notify paragraph names are MET: every leg published canonically by hand (free: czce 34,164 / miax 1,554 / cepea 12,922 incl. the filled 1996-2026 series / jse 18; databento: 15/15 W2), union gates PASS, and the CZCE row floors held across the whole 2,628-file backfill (P10-czce closed). The stop_and_notify rationale above is retained as history.
